brief: Orbit is a local desktop task companion: Redmine and ClickUp tasks become low-poly planets circling on source orbits, and finished work falls into a separate system. The mark should keep the current icon's faceted planet and comet-blue ring, but read as a low-poly world rather than a cube, and hold up at 16 px.
criteria: Keep the hex planet + ring equity; make it unmistakably low-poly; work in one colour, on midnight and on white, and at favicon size.

concepts.name: Shaded Facets
concepts.idea: The app's own low-poly planet: ten lit facets inside the familiar hexagon, with one comet-blue orbit passing in front.
rationale: Keeps the current icon's hexagon, ring and blues, so it still reads as Orbit
An icosphere cut with no centre 'Y', so it reads as a planet, not a cube
The five facet tones are the app palette; the planets in the scene share the mark's DNA
Small-size cut merges facets into three tones; the one-colour version keeps the facets as seams

recommendation: Shaded Facets, used as the app icon on the midnight tile and as the horizontal lockup in the app header.
next_steps: Swap desktop/src-tauri/icons to the new app icon
Use the horizontal lockup in the station / header UI
Run a trademark search before any public release
